rationale: All cited file/line ranges were checked against the actual fixture and are accurate; the reported commands (exit 126 on ./run_checks.sh, 2 passing tests under sh) reproduce exactly, so the evidence is genuine. The package covers every required section, pins CAS in the SQL predicate, keeps authorization server-side, forbids payload-supplied identity, and preserves scope. Deductions: thin boundary rationale, handler tests omit the module-global ACTOR patch and sqlite thread-affinity constraint an implementer will hit, and UI cases lack an automatable harness.
